brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net can you create a site which collates these idioms into a markdown we can feed into an LLM pls? The quoted post and the OP's quoted post

Can we tag you with a post to then get it added? 

bsky.app/profile/vibe...

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@nainrouge420.bsky.social: My agents instructions slowly becoming a collection of the hard-fought lessons learned by folks I’ve never actually met expressed in their particular idioms
  [quoting @demigirlboss.bsky.social: Genuinely I have started asking my agents this when discussing implementations. "Are we about to do a Kubernetes, or is this genuinely a case where the lighter spool-up saves us maintenance headaches and technical debt?"]
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [quoting @vibe-coded.com: I think my number 1 agent tip is "make the agent prove it understands things". that's what almost everything boils down to. the UVs on this book are the best example I have. if you don't do this and then ask the model to do something like "put some text on the front cover" it's going to go wrong]
note: built idioms.bisks.net: the two idioms from the thread, collated into a markdown doc you can copy straight into an agent's instructions. tag me quoting a new one and I'll add it.
